announcements.headline: Final Results for the year ended 31 May 2026
announcements.insight: Falconedge Plc reports final results for the year ended 31 May 2026. This follows earlier monthly Bitcoin yield updates and board changes during the period.

announcements.headline: October Results - Bitcoin Yield
announcements.insight: Falconedge Plc publishes its October Bitcoin Yield results. This follows a July trading update announcing a board change and subsequent director appointments.

announcements.headline: Board Change
announcements.insight: Falconedge Plc announces a board change, following earlier updates in June, July, and August 2026 regarding results and trading.

announcements.headline: July Results - Bitcoin Yield
announcements.insight: Falconedge Plc issued July Results - Bitcoin Yield. This follows May Results and precedes a Trading Update and Board Change announced in July.

announcements.headline: Trading Update and Board Change
announcements.insight: Falconedge Plc announces a trading update and board change. This follows its May results announcement in June 2026.

announcements.headline: May Results - Bitcoin Yield
announcements.insight: Falconedge Plc has released its May results detailing Bitcoin yield. This constitutes a scheduled trading update providing performance data for shareholders.
